name: 14519 · Ontario, NY
findings: ZIP 14519 (Ontario) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14519 (Ontario) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14519 (Ontario) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
